scope: Complete source inventory of the 18 approved application groups, platform surfaces and shared engines. Presence is not a functional-completeness or acceptance claim; historical gap analysis is a planning input requiring current-code confirmation.

modules.name: Dashboard
remaining: Audit live portfolio/property KPIs and configurable widgets; never add fictional commercial values.

modules.name: Daily Hotel
remaining: No registered destination or dedicated Daily Hotel schema/route identified in this candidate.
Implement only the approved property/date operational dataset, revision history, currency snapshots and occupancy/ADR/RevPAR semantics; do not repurpose checklists as revenue records.

modules.name: Diary & Tasks
remaining: Audit operational scheduling, completion, escalation, manager sign-off and multi-property journeys; reuse current operational task engine and forms.

modules.name: Maintenance
remaining: Reconcile existing hospitality and equipment work-order lifecycles under approved D01; preserve history.
Verify staff/front-office/guest QR intake, evidence, asset linking, assignment and verification.

modules.name: Compliance
remaining: Audit register/configuration inheritance, recurring obligations, evidence, expiry/escalation, property isolation and entitlement enforcement.

modules.name: Risk
remaining: Protected unchanged scope; no runtime redevelopment. Reuse existing risk engine and preserve immutable revisions, snapshots and ACLs.

modules.name: Inspections
remaining: Audit hotel inspection/audit programmes, approved templates, evidence, recurrence and Action Plan links.

modules.name: Incidents
remaining: Audit hotel incident taxonomy, investigation, lost-time evidence, scoped reporting and linked corrective actions.

modules.name: Action Plans
remaining: Audit/complete approved typed sources: Compliance, Risk, Inspections/Audits, Incidents, Training and Manual.
Reuse corrective_actions; maintenance is a linked consequence, not a duplicate Action Plan engine.

modules.name: Training
remaining: Audit matrix, courses, providers, assessments, certificates, renewals, People integration and property-scoped evidence.

modules.name: People
remaining: Owner accepted; preserve candidate implementation. Only acceptance gaps may prevent freeze; no feature changes authorized.

modules.name: Handover
remaining: Audit shift/property handover, acknowledgements, comments, attachments and scoped follow-up.

modules.name: Assets & PPM
remaining: Audit asset hierarchy, PPM scheduling, inspection evidence, reminders and canonical maintenance convergence.

modules.name: Metering
remaining: Audit readings, tariffs, historical currency snapshots, property scope and analytics; verify tenant currency defaults against current code.

modules.name: Reporting
remaining: Approved hierarchy contains Reporting but no explicit destination in this candidate; reconcile its intended presentation with Reports without a second reporting engine.

modules.name: Reports
remaining: Audit built-in/custom reports, schedules, delivery, export auditing and all property/tenant filters.

modules.name: Approvals
remaining: Owner accepted; exact recovered production implementation preserved. Complete remaining authenticated acceptance only.

modules.name: Tenant Settings
remaining: Audit tenant/platform ownership, branding, currency/locale/timezone, roles, entitlements, properties, configuration adoption and governed imports.
Inspect existing property-structure import before adding People/Compliance/Assets dataset handlers; preserve one import lifecycle.
Complete Platform/tenant ownership and operator authorization acceptance.
Tenant cloning and demo reset require separately bounded specifications; never clone credentials or permit unscoped database wipes.
Preserve current manual, controlled source/image-bound release requirements.

crossCuttingWork: Active-property/portfolio selection must only narrow server-authorized tenant/property scope.
Configuration governance and immutable template adoption must reuse existing forms/configuration primitives.
Operational notifications only: reuse events/outbox/jobs/preferences/email/SMS/push; no marketing engine.
Private storage, audit/history, CSV/PDF, retries, concurrency and localization across every completed vertical slice.
Uvanoo Light/Terra, teal/coral branding, approved hierarchy, keyboard/accessibility and mobile/tablet acceptance.
No placeholder buttons, fake metrics, duplicate engines, or UI-only authorization.
Keep user manuals and walkthroughs synchronized with implemented workflows.
